title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Commands that answer, hovers that tell the whole story
summary: Turning Logcat or Android Run off made their commands "not found"; toolbar toggles were dead during the first index; a sealed class hover listed one subtype out of four; online docs opened a 404 for every function; the web build lacked four providers the desktop had. All fixed, with cleaner KDoc rendering.

highlights.title: Commands that answer
highlights.description: With Logcat or Android Run disabled, the palette and shortcuts said "command not found" and the Logcat views "no data provider". The commands now explain the setting and offer to enable it; the inline toggles are registered before the first index so the toolbar buttons work at once.

highlights.title: Sealed hover lists every subtype
highlights.description: Subtypes declared after the class, in another file, or implementing a sealed interface were missing from the hover ("Subtypes (1)" for four). The KDoc also follows a relocated declaration, and a name imported from an unindexed library no longer gets another package's hover.

highlights.title: Web parity and docs that exist
highlights.description: vscode.dev gets lifecycle pairing, Room migration drift, resource shadowing and the strings.xml hover, and indexes every values*/*.xml. The online docs fallback opens `launch.html` instead of a 404, and a composable call opens the package summary anchor.

sections.heading: Wiring
bullets: Logcat and Android Run commands stay registered when disabled; the Logcat views hide while off.
Inline feature toggles work during the first index on desktop.
Internal test and Find Usages commands leave the palette; Java projects activate the extension; `statusBarEnabled` applies live; Copy FQN works in Java.
The library sources bar starts as scanning; walkthrough links say to open a file first.

sections.heading: Hover and docs
bullets: Every sealed subtype is listed, from any file; the companion object is not.
KDoc read at the relocated declaration; no name fallback against an explicit import; nothing on import lines.
Dokka function pages and composable anchors in the online docs fallback.
`// TODO` and commented code are not documentation; multi-line annotations, `@property`, trailing `*/`, enum entries and `where` clauses render right.
